g.text: K8: spread the outliers before quantizing, then scale per block
before: two outlier channels set the FP8 step for all 16
after S, then H / sqrt(d): same norm, no channel stands out
the small entries lose most of their 3 mantissa bits
the same information, quantized about 3 bits finer
scores are unchanged: (Q S H)(K S H)^T = Q S H H^T S K^T = Q K^T, since S = diag(+-1) and H H^T = I for H = Hadamard(d) / sqrt(d)
FA3 folds this rotation into the rotary embedding before attention; here it is preprocessing, outside the timed region. V is not rotated.
one scale per (64, d) tile of Q and per (64, d) tile of K, stored as two small FP32 arrays (B, N/64).
In the kernel the score tile for (Q tile i, KV tile j) is multiplied by s_q[i] s_k[j] / sqrt(d): one scalar
read per iteration, served from L1 after the first thread. V keeps one scale per tensor.
A single outlier can now only coarsen its own 64-row block instead of the whole tensor.
